bacterial_leaf_blight.treatments: Use resistant varieties and copper-based bactericides.
bacterial_leaf_blight.prevention: Avoid water stagnation and excessive nitrogen.

leaf_blast.grain_damage: Poor grain quality and yield loss.
leaf_blast.prevention: Use resistant varieties and balanced fertilization.

rice_false_smut.grain_damage: Grains turn into green smut balls.
rice_false_smut.prevention: Avoid excessive nitrogen and use clean seeds.

sheath_blight.treatments: Apply validamycin or other sheath blight fungicides.
sheath_blight.prevention: Proper plant spacing and avoid excessive nitrogen.

tungro_virus.treatments: No chemical cure. Rogue infected plants.
tungro_virus.prevention: Control leafhoppers and use resistant varieties.
